highlights: TO LET FURNISHED. TWO BEDROOMS, BOTH EN-SUITE
summary: The property is subject to a local occupancy clause.
description:
To let, furnished, a first floor apartment with two double bedrooms, both en-suite. A fabulous location with views of Skiddaw at the front. Very well presented with quality fittings. Two designated parking spaces and a communal garden. EPC B.

Located in the heart of the Lake District and within a short drive to Keswick and Cockermouth, this fantastic first floor apartment is available on a furnished basis. Very well presented and spacious with stunning views to the front of the local Lake District Fells.

There is an open plan kitchen diner, good sized living room and two double bedrooms with en-suite to both. A separate wash room/cloakroom off the hall.

The apartment is in a block of six and each apartment has 2 designated parking spaces and share a communal garden and patio. Each apartment has their own timber storage shed.

Council tax band D.

The equivalent of one week's worth of rent is payable as a holding deposit whilst referencing checks are undertaken. One months rent plus the equivalent of 5 weeks rent is payable before occupation.
